name: Identity
description: Explore the depth of who God says you are. This deck is designed to break down insecurities and build a firm foundation on biblical truth through honest sharing and fun challenges.

cards.title: Fearfully & Wonderfully Made
cards.prompt: Explain this verse to the group using only 5 words.
cards.body: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

cards.title: God's Masterpiece
cards.prompt: Name one good thing you think God prepared you to do. The group adds one more for you.
cards.body: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

cards.title: Chosen
cards.prompt: Finish the sentence: 'Being chosen by God means...'
cards.body: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

cards.title: Brand New
cards.prompt: Share one 'old thing' you're glad God is helping you leave behind. Keep it as light or as deep as you like.
cards.body: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

cards.title: Set an Example
cards.prompt: Pick one area from this verse and say how a young person can lead there today.
cards.body: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

cards.prompt: What's a compliment you received that you still remember?
What is something you're naturally good at that people often don't notice?
Which voice is loudest in your life right now: friends, social media, family, or God? Why?
When do you feel most like yourself?
What's one lie about yourself you've believed, and what truth answers it?
If God described you in one sentence, what do you hope it would be?

cards.title: Say It Out Loud
cards.prompt: Look at the person on your right and tell them one real strength you see in them.

cards.title: Mirror Truth
cards.prompt: Say one true thing about yourself out loud that starts with 'God made me...'

cards.title: Name Chain
cards.prompt: Say the name of every person in the group and one thing you admire about each, in 60 seconds.

cards.title: Text a Blessing
cards.prompt: Send a short message to someone telling them why they matter.

cards.title: Pick Your Verse
cards.prompt: Choose a verse from this deck that speaks to you today and read it aloud with confidence.

cards.title: Strength Spotting
cards.prompt: Teams race to write down one strength for every person in the group.
cards.instruction: Each team writes one strength per player. The team with the most completed wins.

cards.title: Verse Relay
cards.prompt: Teams race to find Psalm 139:14, Ephesians 2:10 and 2 Corinthians 5:17 in a real Bible and read each aloud.
cards.instruction: Phones away, Bibles out. First team to read all three correctly wins.

cards.title: Identity Charades
cards.prompt: Act out words about who God says you are: loved, chosen, new, forgiven, made on purpose.
cards.instruction: No talking. One team member acts while the team guesses. Most correct wins.

cards.title: Two Truths and a Testimony
cards.prompt: Share two random facts and one real story of God at work in your life. The group guesses which is the testimony.
cards.instruction: The group gets one guess each. Everyone scores if the testimony is guessed correctly.

cards.prompt: Share a time you felt God's love in an unexpected way.
Tell about a moment when God reminded you who you are.
Share how someone encouraged you when you felt small.
Tell about something you used to feel ashamed of and how God helped. Share only what feels comfortable.
